indicator.name: Facilities with electricity/water (%)
indicator.description: Share of facilities with electricity/water in the Kenya Health Facility Census snapshot.
indicator.expected_source: Ministry of Health — Kenya Health Facility Census Report September 2023
indicator.expected_availability_note: Retired/replaced in P21 because the original field combines electricity and water into one undefined percentage and the official census does not publish one governed 47-county combined amenity series. Use IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK and IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY for source-backed county health-infrastructure supply evidence; do not interpret those successors as electricity/water access rates.
